title: Policy search API and commercial_auto coverage
story: As a CSR I can find a policy by last name, postal code, VIN, phone or policy-number prefix via GET /api/v1/policies?q=, and commercial_auto claims get a coverage verdict.
acceptance: GET /api/v1/policies?q= route exists in src/modules/coverage/routes.mjs, requires role csr, agent, adjuster or supervisor (403 otherwise), 400 on empty q, tenant-isolated

q is classified (VIN = 17 chars no I/O/Q; phone = 7+ digits after stripping punctuation; postal code; policy-number prefix like ABC-123; else last name) and PII fields match only via ctx.crypto.hmacIndex blind indexes; no plaintext PII column added

Response is PolicySummary[] with policyNumber, lob, status, insured display name, masked contact (e.g. ***-***-1234), risk state, short vehicle/property description; no full phone, address or DOB in output
Policy-number prefix search works via a non-PII indexed column/LIKE and is capped (limit 25)

verifyCoverage handles lob commercial_auto: fleet units matched by VIN/unit id, hired/non-owned auto covered when HNOA coverage present, cargo losses excluded unless CARGO endorsement; at least 2 commercial_auto fixtures added
node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/coverage/*.test.mjs passes, including new policy-search.test.mjs and commercial-auto.test.mjs; existing tests still pass
brief: Extend the existing coverage module (already built: port.mjs, adapters/ mock-pas, service.mjs searchPolicies, verify.mjs evaluateCoverage, fixtures.mjs, routes.mjs). 1) Search: add a service fn searchByQuery(q, {limit}) that classifies q and delegates to the port adapter's search(criteria); extend the mock-pas adapter additively with policyNumberPrefix (plain column LIKE 'PFX%', policy numbers are not PII) and keep AND semantics for searchPolicies. Reuse the existing last_name_idx/postal_idx/vin_idx/phone_idx comma-delimited blind-index columns; normalise (lowercase, strip non-digits for phone, uppercase VIN) the same way seedPolicies does before hmacIndex. Add a summarizer producing PolicySummary with decrypted name via ctx.crypto.decryptPii and masked contact; never log PII. Register GET /api/v1/policies in routes.mjs using req.ctx (tenant-bound) and the router's role guard pattern already used for the snapshot route. Static route must not clash with /policies/:policyNumber/snapshot. 2) Commercial auto: extend verify.mjs rule function and PolicySnapshot fixtures: fleet units (vehicles[] with unitId/vin), HNOA coverage code, cargo excluded unless endorsement CARGO; map outcomes onto the existing status/outcome table (excluded, needs_review when unit not identified). Add fixtures (synthetic names/VINs only) to fixtures.mjs so the platform seed picks them up. Tests: use tests/unit/coverage/helpers.mjs and fake-claims.mjs; run with a glob (node --test on a directory fails on Node 22). If the contract lacks the q endpoint or masked fields, post a contract-change to architecture and add the smallest additive change, documented in the result. Do not touch other teams' paths.

verdicts.reason: All criteria met; 98 coverage tests pass; masked summaries, blind-index PII, 2 commercial_auto fixtures; only regression is openapi route snapshot drift from contract additions, not ticket files
